entries.1c2747aa0b3a8f40: An international logistics operator in the marine customs brokerage sector, headquartered in Chuo-ku, Kobe City. The company, together with one consolidated subsidiary and six equity-method affiliates, forms the group, and employees as of March 31, 2026 numbered 308. Listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.2cca79884b8bacf4: A reportable segment that, on consignment from shippers (export traders), prepares export documents and nego documents, packs export cargo, performs customs clearance, transports cargo to vessels at ports, delivers it locally, and carries out installation at delivery destinations and others. It carries out operations from documentation through cargo handling under an integrated responsibility system at the five major ports (Kobe, Osaka, Nagoya, Keihin and Yokohama). Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,725 million. Equity-method affiliate Hanshin Container Transport Co., Ltd. handles ocean container transport, Mikasa Rikuun Co., Ltd. handles truck transport, and Hirose Sangyo Kaiun Co., Ltd. handles lighter transport.
